title: Smoothly Optimized
description: Smoothly Optimized is a powerful modpack designed to significantly improve Minecraft's performance using top-tier optimization mods. It boosts FPS, speeds up chunk loading, reduces memory usage, and improves startup times.
body:
# ꜱᴍᴏᴏᴛʜʟʏ ᴏᴘᴛɪᴍɪᴢᴇᴅ
**Smoothly Optimized** is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to significantly improve FPS, reduce stutters, speed up chunk loading, and delivers a smoother gameplay experience using a carefully selected set of optimization mods. Depending on your hardware and settings, users may experience substantial FPS improvements, often gaining **_hundreds_** of additional frames per second. The Mod Dependencies of these mods are included in the Modpack.

**List of Mods:**
1. [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) - A high-performance rendering engine replacement for Minecraft, which greatly improves frame rates and reduces micro-stutter.
2. [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) - A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
3. [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - No-compromises game logic optimization mod, useful for both single-player games and multi-player servers.
4. [Ferritecore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - Memory usage optimizations mod.
5. [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - Speeds up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft.
6. [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton) - A mod to optimize the Minecraft networking stack.
7. [GPUBooster](https://modrinth.com/mod/gputape) - Provides DSA & fastest math formulas to game render system for best perfomance! Compatible with Sodium/Embeddium, Iris and shaders.
8. [Scalable Lux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) - A Fabric mod based on Starlight that improves the performance of light updates in Minecraft.
9. [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible.
10. [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling) - A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance.
11. [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities) / [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe) - Minecraft Optimization mod that improves framerates by improving block entity rendering via a hybrid renderer as well as reduces block entity FPS Lag with almost no Compromises.
12. [IdleTweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/idletweaks) / [DynamicFPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) - Reduces Minecraft's resource usage while it runs in the background, idle, or on battery.
13. [NotEnoughCrashes](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughcrashes) - When crashing, you can go back to the title screen and keep playing, without needing to restart, alongside other things to make crashes more pleasant.
14. [Noxesium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noxesium) - Improves play experience on multiplayer servers.
15. [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisiumforked) - Optimizes worldgen performance for a better gameplay experience.
16. [Modernfix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) - All-in-one mod that improves performance, reduces memory usage, and fixes many bugs.
17. [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) - A Fabric mod designed to improve the chunk performance of Minecraft.
18. [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations/versions) - Optimization mod that focuses on things other than rendering.
19. [YetAnotherConfigLib YACL (Mod Dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
20. [ClothConfigAPI (Mod Dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
21. [ModMenu (Mod Dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
22. [ToadLib (Mod Dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/toadlib)
23. [Fabric API (Mod Dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

![The Word "Smoothly Optimized" written in a stylish way on a black Background with Light Green and White as the Primary Colours.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f01aaf9c8183e0e16d2449d0e9db2a7440fece6.png)

**Note:** Keep in Mind to Turn off V-Sync and Set Max Framerates to Unlimited in Sodium's Video Settings.
